blocks.text: 简要说明

inlines.text: 简要说明
Claude 没有自己的图像模型。连接器让它能调用一个图像模型，并返回真实的图片。
在 Claude 应用或 Claude Code 中把
https://mcp.openrouter.ai/mcp
添加为连接器。你的电脑上无需安装任何东西。
在请求中指明你想要的模型，或者先让 Claude 针对你的任务比较各模型，这一步不收费。
2026 年 11 月 19 日，我们的测试图片每张花费在 0.035 到 0.10 美元之间，每张图片在计费前都需要你确认。
图片会直接出现在对话中，或以一个 24 小时内有效的链接形式提供。

blocks.text: Claude 能生成图像吗？

inlines.text: Claude 能生成图像吗？

blocks.text: Claude 无法自行生成照片或插图。Anthropic 于 2026 年 3 月 16 日发布的帮助中心文章写道：“Claude 不会像图像生成工具那样生成照片或插图”，并指出它用 HTML 和 SVG 来构建示意图和图表。其视觉文档还补充道：“Claude 只是一个图像理解模型。它可以解读和分析图像，但无法生成、产出、编辑、处理或创建图像。”

inlines.text: Claude 无法自行生成照片或插图。Anthropic 于 2026 年 3 月 16 日发布的
帮助中心文章
写道：“Claude 不会像图像生成工具那样生成照片或插图”，并指出它用 HTML 和 SVG 来构建示意图和图表。其
视觉文档
还补充道：“Claude 只是一个图像理解模型。它可以解读和分析图像，但无法生成、产出、编辑、处理或创建图像。”

blocks.text: 连接器是 Claude 对添加到应用中的 MCP 服务器的叫法。OpenRouter MCP 服务器就是这样一个连接器，它可接入OpenRouter 图像目录中的所有模型。

blocks.text: Claude 用图像模型做什么？

inlines.text: Claude 用图像模型做什么？

blocks.text: 图像模型负责画图，Claude 负责画图之外的各项工作。如果只用图像工具，这些周边工作才是难点：你得自己写详细的提示词，图片生成后还要对照要求检查，并把文件搬运到该放的地方。

inlines.text: 图像模型负责画图，Claude 负责画图之外的各项工作。如果只用图像工具，这些周边工作才是难点：你得自己写详细的提示词，图片生成后还要对照要求检查，并把文件搬运到该放的地方。

blocks.text: 在 Claude 中，简短的需求就够了，因为详细的提示词由 Claude 来写。指明你想要的模型，例如：“你能生成一张图片吗？画面是一只红狐在雪夜的街灯下读一本平装书，柔和的水彩风格。使用 Seedream 5.5。”在我们的测试中，Claude 把这句话扩展成了更长的提示词。每张图片生成前，Claude 都会请求批准，批准界面会显示所用模型和它写的提示词，你可以在产生任何费用之前先读一遍。

blocks.text: 把 OpenRouter MCP 服务器添加为自定义连接器。它是远程服务器，因此你的电脑上无需安装任何东西。你需要一个带有额度的 OpenRouter 账户。

blocks.text: 在 Claude 应用中：

inlines.text: 在 Claude 应用中：
打开“设置”>“连接器”，添加一个自定义连接器。
将其命名为
OpenRouter MCP
，并把远程 MCP 服务器 URL 设为
https://mcp.openrouter.ai/mcp
。OAuth 相关字段留空。
添加连接器，然后连接它。浏览器中会打开 OpenRouter 的授权页面。
批准这个连接专用的密钥。密钥会在 7 天内过期，你随时可以断开连接。

claude mcp login openrouter

blocks.text: generate-image 工具在能签发链接时会返回链接，否则返回图片本身。链接可在任何浏览器中打开，无需登录，有效期为 24 小时。

blocks.text: 在 Claude 应用中，图片会显示在聊天里，Claude 也能看到它。链接则会在你的浏览器中打开，而在我们的运行中，Claude 并没有看到那张图，也无法在聊天中显示它。在 Claude Code 中，链接反而是更方便的情况，因为图片会直接下载到你的项目里。直接返回的图片会留在 Claude Code 自己的文件夹中，直到你批准复制它。

blocks.text: Tl;dr

inlines.text: Tl;dr
Claude has no image model of its own. A connector lets it call one and return a real picture.
Add
https://mcp.openrouter.ai/mcp
as a connector in the Claude app or Claude Code. Nothing is installed on your computer.
Name the model you want in your request, or ask Claude to compare models for your job first, which is not billed.
Our test images cost between $0.035 and $0.10 each on November 19, 2026, and you approve each one before it is charged.
The picture arrives either in the chat or as a link that works for 24 hours.

blocks.text: Can Claude generate images?

inlines.text: Can Claude generate images?

blocks.text: Claude cannot generate photos or illustrations on its own. Anthropic’s March 16, 2026 Help Center article says “Claude doesn’t generate photos or illustrations the way image-generation tools do” and notes that it builds diagrams and charts with HTML and SVG. Its vision documentation adds: “Claude is an image understanding model only. It can interpret and analyze images, but it cannot generate, produce, edit, manipulate, or create images.”

blocks.text: What does Claude do with an image model?

inlines.text: What does Claude do with an image model?

blocks.text: The image model draws, and Claude does the work around the drawing. With an image tool on its own, that surrounding work is the hard part: you write the detailed prompt yourself, and once the picture arrives you check it against your request and carry the file to where it belongs.

inlines.text: The image model draws, and Claude does the work around the drawing. With an image tool on its own, that surrounding work is the hard part: you write the detailed prompt yourself, and once the picture arrives you check it against your request and carry the file to where it belongs.

blocks.text: In Claude, a short request is enough, because Claude writes the detailed prompt. Name the model you want, for example: “Can you generate an image of a red fox reading a paperback under a streetlamp on a snowy night, in soft watercolor? Use Seedream 5.5.” In our run, Claude expanded that line into a longer prompt. Claude asks for approval before each image, and that approval shows the model and the prompt it wrote, so you can read it before anything is billed.

When that happens, a mismatch gets caught without you comparing the picture to your request yourself. blocks.text: How to make images in Claude with a connector

inlines.text: How to make images in Claude with a connector

blocks.text: Add the OpenRouter MCP server as a custom connector. It is a remote server, so nothing is installed on your computer. You need an OpenRouter account with credits.

inlines.text: Add the OpenRouter MCP server as a custom connector. It is a remote server, so nothing is installed on your computer. You need an OpenRouter account with credits.

blocks.text: In the Claude app:

inlines.text: In the Claude app:
Open Settings > Connectors and add a custom connector.
Name it
OpenRouter MCP
and set the remote MCP server URL to
https://mcp.openrouter.ai/mcp
. Leave the OAuth fields blank.
Add the connector, then connect it. An OpenRouter consent page opens in your browser.
Approve the dedicated key for this connection. It expires within 7 days, and you can disconnect at any time.

blocks.text: Some organizations do not allow custom connectors, so this option may be missing on a work account.

inlines.text: Some organizations do not allow custom connectors, so this option may be missing on a work account.

blocks.text: In Claude Code, run:

inlines.text: In Claude Code, run:

blocks.text:
claude mcp add --transport http openrouter https://mcp.openrouter.ai/mcp
claude mcp login openrouter

blocks.text: Why does the image sometimes come back as a link?

inlines.text: Why does the image sometimes come back as a link?

blocks.text: The generate-image tool returns a link when one can be issued, and the image itself otherwise. A link opens in any browser, without signing in, for 24 hours.

inlines.text: The
generate-image
tool returns a link when one can be issued, and the image itself otherwise. A link opens in any browser, without signing in, for 24 hours.

blocks.text: In the Claude app, an image shows in the chat and Claude can see it. A link opens in your browser, and in our run Claude had not seen that picture and could not show it in the chat. In Claude Code, a link is the easier case, because the image downloads straight into your project. An image that comes back directly stays in Claude Code’s own folder until you approve copying it.

blocks.text: Which one you get varied between requests, even for the same model. In our small set of runs on November 19, 2026, Seedream 5.5 returned the image itself 4 of 4 times, GPT Image 2.6 Flare returned a link 3 of 4 times, FLUX 3 Image returned a link 2 of 2 times, and Nano Banana 2.1 returned each once. If you want the picture inside the Claude app, Seedream 5.5 did that every time for us. If you get a link, open it.
